mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, c.code AS type, c.name AS typeName, c.code AS category, c.name AS categoryName, p.description, p.location_text AS location, p.area_code AS area, p.area_name AS areaName, p.address, COALESCE(p.province, pg.city) AS province, COALESCE(p.city, pg.city) AS city, p.image_url AS image, p.longitude, p.latitude, DATE_FORMAT(p.open_time, '%H:%i') AS openTime, DATE_FORMAT(p.close_time, '%H:%i') AS closeTime, p.phone, p.rating, p.rating AS score, p.hotness, p.visit_count AS visits, pg.id AS placeGroupId, pg.name AS placeGroupName, pg.short_name AS shortName, pg.district, 0 AS distance
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pois WHERE id = #{targetId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO favorites (user_id, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})

INSERT INTO user_spot_actions (user_id, target_type, target_id, action_type, active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{actionType}, #{active}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active = VALUES(active), updated_at = NOW()
INSERT INTO browsing_history (user_id, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})

INSERT INTO user_preferences (user_id, tag_id, source, weight) SELECT DISTINCT #{userId}, str.tag_id, #{source}, #{weight} FROM pois p JOIN spots s ON s.id = p.spot_id OR s.representative_poi_id = p.id OR s.legacy_poi_id = p.id JOIN spot_tag_relations str ON str.spot_id = s.id WHERE p.id = #{targetId} AND p.status = 1 AND s.status = 1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = GREATEST(-10.00, LEAST(10.00, weight + VALUES(weight))), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE pois SET visit_count = visit_count + 1, hotness = hotness + 1 WHERE id = #{targetId}
UPDATE spots s JOIN pois p ON p.id = #{targetId} SET s.visit_count = s.visit_count + 1, s.hotness = s.hotness + 1 WHERE s.id = p.spot_id OR s.representative_poi_id = p.id

SELECT
FROM user_spot_actions a JOIN pois p ON p.id = a.target_id JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = p.place_group_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.target_type = 'poi' AND a.action_type = #{actionType} AND a.active = 1 AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_spot_actions a JOIN pois p ON p.id = a.target_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.target_type = 'poi' AND a.action_type = #{actionType} AND a.active = 1 AND p.status = 1

SELECT
FROM favorites f JOIN pois p ON p.id = f.target_id JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = p.place_group_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'poi' AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorites f JOIN pois p ON p.id = f.target_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'poi' AND p.status = 1

SELECT
FROM ( SELECT target_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_view_at FROM browsing_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_type = 'poi' GROUP BY target_id ) h JOIN pois p ON p.id = h.target_id JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = p.place_group_id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY h.last_view_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.target_id) FROM browsing_history h JOIN pois p ON p.id = h.target_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.target_type = 'poi' AND p.status = 1
